multisig.note: k-of-n Taproot accounts in Advanced mode, members from this phone, paired Ledgers and keys others sent; MuSig2 removed

hw_signer.note: Pairs a Ledger over Bluetooth as a multisig member, registers the account on it and has it sign; the everyday wallet signs in-app; this build has paired only a simulated Ledger so far

psbt.note: Multisig accounts only: copy a BIP174 v0 PSBT to share and paste co-signers' PSBTs back; the everyday wallet signs in-app

watch_only.note: Descriptor-only backup JSON restores watch-only; no xpub or address entry; joined accounts must include this phone's key

passphrase.note: Seed is derived with BIP39's empty default passphrase on create and import; no passphrase field anywhere in the app

coin_control.note: Send picks coins automatically, largest first, for the wallet and multisig accounts; an account's coin list is read-only

fee_bump.note: RBF Bump fee in Advanced mode for own pending sends with unspent change; accounts only rebroadcast or give up; no CPFP

taproot.note: Receives to BIP86 bc1p addresses by default; multisig accounts are Taproot too (script path, NUMS internal key)

descriptors.note: Multisig accounts join from and share a tr() descriptor; the everyday wallet's is only inside its backup file

own_server.note: Manual host:port peers under Advanced mode, tried first; peer must serve compact filters; pool still fills from others

verifies_chain.note: Checks header work, cross-checks filter headers across peers, matches filters locally; merkle-checks fetched blocks

tor.note: No bundled Tor or I2P client; routes peers through SOCKS gateways you run, found on Tailscale or set by hand

seed_standard.note: 12-word BIP39 phrase on BIP86 paths, shown in Advanced mode; the app restores only from its backup file, not the words alone

cloud_backup.note: On by default: AES-256-GCM copy in the person's private CloudKit database, key in iCloud Keychain; backup file too
